component.name: Wealthfolio
component.summary: Private, local-first tracker for investments, net worth and spending

description.p: This is a community package of Wealthfolio, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Wealthfolio is a personal finance tracker that keeps your data on your own computer. It tracks:

ul.li: Investment accounts and holdings, with performance, income and allocation views.
Net worth across accounts and assets.
Goals, contribution limits and what-if simulations.

description.p: Activities can be entered by hand or imported from CSV, and prices and exchange rates are fetched from market data providers. Add-ons extend it with new pages and data sources.

The package has network access for market data and the optional sync service, and talks to your desktop keyring, where the application keeps its secrets. It has no filesystem grant: your accounts live in a local database in the application's private per-app directory, and CSV imports, exports and backups go through the file chooser portal.
Updates come through Flatpak. If the application offers to install an update itself, ignore it and update with Flatpak instead.
